findings.message: When the magic __serialize() and __unserialize() methods are available and the code base does not need to support PHP < 7.4, the implementation of the Serializable interface can be removed. (the class also has __serialize()/__unserialize(), so PHP does not emit the Serializable deprecation)

'enum' is a soft reserved keyword as of PHP version 8.1 and should not be used to name a class, interface, trait or enum or as part of a namespace (class declaration) (since PHP 8.1 enum is a keyword only when another name follows it, so a class named Enum (class Enum extends X) stays valid PHP)

The "Runnable" interface extends the serializable serializable interface. For the PHPCompatibility.Interface.RemovedSerializable sniff to be reliable, the name of this interface needs to be added to the list of interface implementations to find. Please add the interface name "Runnable" to the "serializableInterfaces" property for this sniff in your custom ruleset and rescan the codebase.
